relationship_model: sync-docs workflow -> product-engineering rule and source-of-truth anchors
i18n audit workflow -> locale/text checks when documentation changes UI text or locale guidance
docs source files -> current truth targets that must stay aligned with agent/workflow registries
requirements: Resolve every capability and source_docs path before editing docs.
Use sync-docs as the primary workflow for all docs changes.
Use audit-i18n-coverage when docs changes add or rename UI text, locale keys or extension copy.
If docs mention a rule, skill, workflow, report path or agent that is not defined, report Capability Drift and fix the registry/docs together.

conditional.when: Docs mention UI labels, locale keys, extension copy or public-facing translated text

operating_workflow.action: Inspect code-owned truth for IPC, preload, providers, store slices, locales, extension, release and agent assets.
Compare truth with target docs and classify missing, stale, broken path, report path and agent classification drift.
Apply minimal docs edits in the existing language/style unless the user asks for a rewrite.
Validate Markdown/JSON references and summarize updated files.

completion_rules: Do not rewrite docs from memory when a defined code-truth anchor or workflow can be read.
Every documented rule/skill/workflow/agent/report path must exist or be listed under Capability Drift.
Final verification must include JSON/reference validation when agent docs or PROMPTS.md changed.
